svg.title: Each occurrence receives δiWj, allocation among at most H costs δi/H, and moving support costs the displayed exponential. The fibers partition the old occurrences, so their product is exactly λi(H, l)s Q j Wj, as used by OE8. Apply finite marker fusion with these fibers, the cover and occupancy bounds and both smallness inequalities. The original allowances bound the actual local analytic norms and δi ≤1 preserves them. Positive background normalization is the actual stage density by the stage representation. Fusion gives local group functions and dominated profiles representing the exactly grouped polynomial, with remainder 4/W ′ γ. Pruning to W ′ γ/8 gives 4/W ′ γ = 1/[2(W ′ γ/8)], the next-step bound. Newly grouped leading counterterms are zero. Translations and reflections of functions/profiles persist because all copies use the same grouping. At the terminal join there is one group per copy and no 1/8 pruning before normalization: its allowance is Q j λi(H, l)Wj, with remainder four divided by it.
